against_005k.note: Different locked sets; failure kinds are compared, not scores.

A05L-28.what: A correct conflict answer (15 days vs 25 days, both cited) named the source document '가상 하람이주청 U-3 운영지침(2026년판)'. The claim-support check read '2026년' as a period that contradicts the cited 15/25 days: raw claim_support failed and the guard withheld the answer.
A05L-28.root_cause: A year inside a document title (edition) is treated as a duration claim; titles of admissible evidence are not used as support.

A05L-29.what: Correct conflict answer (20,000 vs 26,000 won) named the same 2026 edition title; raw scoring passed it, but the guard found '2026년' unsupported and withheld it (false block).

A05L-42.what: Partial answer gave the place but did not name the missing processing time; the system notice named it.

A05L-48.what: Partial answer without naming the missing fee; notice named it.

spec_gap_found.what: The suite gave unverified/pending records the verification method 'registry_lookup'. The registry code ignores any record whose method is not 'synthetic_fixture' inside a synthetic-fixture registry (and the reverse for a real registry), so these were rejected as no_registry_record instead of the expected reason; A05L-12 became system_withheld instead of review_required. The spec does not state this rule.
spec_gap_found.safety_effect: None: every such record was still rejected (fail-closed) and all nine cases were end-to-end correct.
spec_gap_found.metric_effect: pre-inference reasons 72/81, selection and outcome 80/81 (not gate thresholds that failed)
